quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson discusses the Hall of Fame criteria
quotes.excerpt: I honestly think that the Hall of Fame is been watered down a little bit
quotes.quote: I honestly think that the Hall of Fame is been watered down a little bit, and I'm being honest. I think a lot of people that I see Hall of Fame, because when I grew up, it was like Magic Johnson, it was like Michael Jordan, it was like Shaquille O'Neal. It was just some of the best basketball players to ever touch the ball. And then when they put out the top 75 players, and this is what made me kind of have this take, when they put out the top 75 players and there was a bunch of guys missing like Kyrie Irving and Dwight Howard, I was confused. So now I see players like Damian Lillard and others, so now you're telling me that you'd rather take Damian Lillard over Kyrie Irving? Or you'd rather take Damian Lillard over Tracy McGrady? So I'm speaking in terms of what I've seen from the top 75.
